theme: An open day in Maine — one 10 o'clock visit, then it's yours.
greeting: Morning, Dan. The calendar is nearly clear today — a 10 AM virtual visit is the only fixed point — while tomorrow carries the weight, with Mike's ultrasound and MRI back to back. A good day to knock down the overdue list and get ahead of Thursday's surgery.

needsAttention.title: Virtual visit at 10 AM
needsAttention.detail: Your Talkiatry follow-up with Dr. Jennifer Snowden is at 10:00 AM ET. It is not on your Google calendar, so it is easy to slide past.

needsAttention.title: Pick a time with Eugenia
needsAttention.detail: On the PRI thread she offered Monday 12–2 or Thursday windows your time and is waiting on you to choose one.

needsAttention.title: Lock down Mike's surgery logistics
needsAttention.detail: His oral surgery in Portland is Thursday; today's prep items are confirming the driver and the insurance and what's owed. The task has sat open in Todoist since Aug 14.

needsAttention.title: Croatia flights still unbought
needsAttention.detail: Open since Aug 15 in Todoist — and the surgery note flags avoiding flights Aug 20–23, so it is worth checking those dates before you book.

resolved: Dan MacNaughton wrote back on your boat hunt with models to chase — a Luders 33 in Penobscot among them.

recipe.title: Composed summer salad with french feta
recipe.why: High summer on the Maine coast has the farmstands at their peak, and a composed salad lets ripe tomatoes and briny French feta carry a warm, low-effort evening on your own.

acts.line: An open morning, with nothing on the calendar until early afternoon.
Your 2 o'clock call with Mike is the day's one fixed point.
Quiet time to pack the small travel bags before tomorrow's 10 AM follow-up.
